policy: Exclude only the named internal assertion when the pinned source hash and source predicate both match. Preserve the raw WPT result.

defects.assertion_name_contains: at boundary of <title> and <div> in <head> should not join them

defects.assertion_name_contains: from <div> around invisible <head> element should not delete the <head>
